svg.title: dsh-fmea-table-check four reading surfaces with a dual outlet
svg.desc: Eight rules read one FMEA worksheet at four surfaces: the header (FM-007), the analysis chain (FM-001, FM-008), the scores (FM-002, FM-003) and the action closure (FM-004, FM-005, FM-006). Each rule shows the engine's own check kind; unset configuration is dashed. The material and the rule pack both feed every surface, so no surface gates another. One run leaves 1 issue (FM-003, row 1, field rpn: 100 differs from 8 × 4 × 3 = 96) and 2 skipped rules (FM-004 threshold 0, FM-006 values []); issues carry locator, found, expected, fix and basis, skipped carries rule and reason, and buildView adds the counts and the disclaimer.

text.font-family: Consolas,'Microsoft YaHei',ui-monospace,monospace
'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: Eight rules read one worksheet at four surfaces; an empty issue list is never “all clear”.
